company.name: Aura Vision
company.shortDescription: Aura Vision is digitising physical retail with plug & play AI to maximise the value of every customer.
company.description:
Aura Vision enables brick-and-mortar retailers to positively influence shopper journeys with cutting-edge computer vision.

The company help brands and retailers improve their in-store experiences by tracking visitor demographics, movement and engagement from existing security cameras.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that converts existing CCTV footage into anonymous, AI-driven retail analytics to measure footfall, customer demographics, and in-store behavior without additional sensors.
productsAndServices.name: In-store Analytics Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service that provides accurate counts of store visitors and analyzes conversion rates by comparing foot traffic to actual purchases using AI on CCTV footage.
productsAndServices.name: Footfall Counting and Conversion Analysis

productsAndServices.description: A tool that helps retail managers plan and allocate staff resources based on real-time and historical customer traffic data to meet demand efficiently.
productsAndServices.name: Staff Planning Optimization

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven analysis that identifies key moments and customer behaviors along the in-store journey to improve store design, marketing, and merchandising effectiveness.
productsAndServices.name: Path to Purchase Analysis

productsAndServices.description: A platform that delivers competitive insights on product engagement and customer demographics to retail brand partners, supporting marketing and sales strategies.
productsAndServices.name: Brand Performance Platform

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,150,000, or 88.02% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,672,074 to $9,170,717, a 5.48x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 54 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 38 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include RetailNext, V-Count, Xovis AG.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
